question.text: Let $P$ be the mid-point of a chord joining the vertex of the parabola $y^{2}=8 x$ to another point on it. Then, the locus of $P$ is

solution.text: Let the chord be MN. Let other end of chord joining from vertex to it lying on $y^{2}=8 x$ be $N\left(2 t^{2}, 4 t\right)$ $\therefore$ Mid-point of $M N=\left(t^{2}, 2 t\right)$ $\therefore \quad x=t^{2}, y=2 t \Rightarrow x=\left(\frac{y}{2}\right)^{2}$ $\Rightarrow \quad y^{2}=4 x$ is the required locus of $P$
